Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-canoe-seakayak/

Paddle a handcrafted wooden sea kayak made from local timber and explore the rich natural beauty of Naguri Lake on this eco-tour.

【Cost】
Adults: ¥6,000 | Elementary school children and younger: ¥4,000
(Includes guide, insurance, kayak rental, and food)

【Capacity】
2 people per kayak × 2 kayaks

【Guide】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop staff

【What to bring】
Drink, towel, change of clothes (you may get wet), clothes you don't mind getting wet, and sun protection items (hat, sunglasses, etc.) as needed.

【More information】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
